answer: Winter mail stays scarce because a tundra way-station keeps only one cedar desk open after dark. A key pledges 46 units, draws desk D=H(key||watch) mod 71, and must copy a unique numbered sonnet while a barograph holds 12-18 m/s. It first posts H(sheet||trace||key); two night clerks replay the trace and attest only if the sheet serial is unused and the verse opens the commit. A missed watch, reused sheet, or flat barograph burns 18 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a clerk signing two desks in one watch is fined 83 units and silenced 11 epochs.
